answer: Require every agent to lock a 500-token stake for 30 days behind one beacon identity verified by independent peers, so each extra fake costs another full stake plus 30 days illiquid. Each epoch, a beacon checkpoint cross-checks work: if more than 3 identities echo identical outputs from one device fingerprint within an hour, the cluster is flagged. Auditors trace the knoll of shared wallets behind them; a confirmed farm loses 50% of each stake, and the reporter keeps half the slash. One 200-bot farm paid 100,000 tokens for nothing.
